note: ADMINISTRATION register screens at SmartPRS 2 parity. `banks` SUPERSEDES the one-column entry in modules.json (a drop-in wins) with SmartPRS 2's account holder / number / IFSC / branch / purpose; `smtp-settings` is SmartPRS 2's Email / SMTP Settings, one server per company, the password typed as a password and never mailed from here. Columns come from database/migrations/2026_03_02_000700_admin_tables.php.

modules.label: Banks
modules.description: Bank accounts with account number, IFSC and purpose — the accounts salary and vendor payouts leave from.

modules.label: Email / SMTP Settings
modules.description: The mail server each company's letters and payslips go out through. Nothing is sent from this screen; a wrong password shows up in Mail Log, not here.

employer_company_id.label: Company
employer_company_id.help: One server per company; leave blank for the server every company falls back to.

from_name.label: From Name
from_name.help: What the recipient sees, e.g. the company's HR desk
